title: Smart reports, surveys, and pooled group budgets for Claude Enterprise
summary: Three Claude Enterprise features are now generally available: smart reports, in-app surveys, and pooled group budgets. Smart reports sample a team's transcripts, group work into workstreams, and show spend, deliverables, friction points, and skill recommendations, but are not meant for evaluating individuals. Pooled budgets give a team a shared monthly budget with individual limits as guardrails and alerts at 50, 75, 95, and 100%, helping admins see where Claude creates value and avoid unused budget.

title: Claude for Financial Advisors
summary: Claude for Financial Advisors is a suite of connectors and workflow skills that link Claude to custodians, portfolio platforms, CRMs, and planning tools, with 20+ partner connectors including Schwab, BlackRock, Addepar, Wealthbox, and Orion. Skills cover meeting prep, follow-up, rebalance review, estate and tax checks, and compliance screening such as SEC Marketing Rule flags, and Claude stages CRM updates and client communications for advisor approval. The plugin is available now, and Enterprise plans are recommended for audit logs.

title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
summary: Claude Duet is a research-preview cloud-computer agent that works across connected apps and keeps running after the app closes. It requires approval before sensitive messages, payments, or deletions, enforced by a separate automated check outside the model, and purchases use one-time cards limited to one merchant and amount. A classifier blocks sharing credentials and card, bank, or ID numbers, and Duet never sees passwords, cookies, or tokens because it runs in an isolated browser VM, though Anthropic notes its safeguards are still being refined and may occasionally miss issues.

title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
summary: Anthropic and Theorem used Claude to write formal proofs that open-source software is free of certain crashes, covering 239 entry points across 123 libraries with inputs up to 64 MB by checking compiled RISC-V code. The work converted fuzz tests into formal specifications and found bugs fuzzing missed, including a decade-old logic bug. The authors caution that formally verified does not mean bug-free, since the proofs assume single-threaded static RISC-V Linux binaries, but they expect falling proof costs to make formal verification standard in secure development.

title: Claude Cowork and chat come together for Enterprise
summary: Claude Enterprise now offers one unified experience combining chat and Cowork across web, desktop, and mobile, and it is generally available. Chat tasks that need code or files move to an Anthropic-managed cloud environment where work continues after the laptop closes, with each agentic session isolated in its own VM and network egress off by default. Admins gain role access, model entitlements, spend limits, a new Efficient mode using Sonnet and Haiku, and pooled group budgets, while SSO and the Compliance API still apply and ZDR, HIPAA-ready, and CMEK orgs stay on their current setup.

title: IDC brings Quanta into Claude and adopts Claude across the company
summary: IDC's Quanta technology intelligence platform is now available as an MCP connector in Claude, letting users generate competitor briefs, vendor shortlists, and forecast comparisons with IDC source citations. It works in the Claude app, Cowork, and Microsoft Office add-ins and is available to IDC Quanta customers using Claude. IDC reports its internal rollout cut data repository rebuilds from about 3 months to 3 weeks and reduced code review from 5 days to about 30 minutes.
